data.name: Arfatun
data.gender_notes: Arfatun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arfatun is an Arabic name for boys, derived from the word 'arfat' which means 'exalted' or 'noble'. The name Arfatun carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Arfatun usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arfatun is a name that signifies spiritual growth, self-realization, and the pursuit of inner wisdom.
data.etymology: Arfatun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arfatun total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
